Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Mercer Island for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 2 of them free. New in this update: The Nutcracker and the Mouse King at Youth Theatre Northwest (from December 5), Island Youth Ballet Excerpts from The Nutcracker (from December 11) and The Dickens Carolers at Mercer Island Library (December 12). We check every date on the host’s own website or an official city calendar, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our Washington Christmas events for kids guide.

Planning a bigger day out? Mercer Island families also use our guide to Christmas events for kids in Seattle, which covers Seattle Center Winterfest, WildLanterns, the North Pole Limited Santa train and more.
